purpose: Define provider-independent source identity, accepted-lineage transitions, and non-authoritative replica observations for AXIOM source continuity.
core_invariant: A repository host may publish or coordinate AXIOM source; it does not define AXIOM source identity or accepted lineage.
claim_boundary: This contract does not make GitHub, Forgejo, GitLab, Radicle, or any agent-native forge an authority over AXIOM source lineage.
This contract does not yet implement Grid persistence, mirror synchronization, provider adapters, or a loss-of-provider recovery drill.
This contract does not claim current source signatures are post-quantum secure.
A content-addressed source-state or transition object is not accepted merely because it validates structurally.
